title: Records relating to hire of visiting instructors from the Murray Galinson San Diego-Israel Initiative (MGSDII)

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: Records relating to hire of visiting instructors from the Murray Galinson San Diego-Israel Initiative (MGSDII)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1- all email correspondence to/from the Department Chairs of SDSU's History, Political Science, and Literature Departments containing the keywords "Murray Galinson" or "San Diego-Israel Initiative," or discussing the placement of a Murray Galinson San Diego-Israel Initiative Visiting Faculty members to offer SDSU courses, from January 1, 2023 to the date of this request's fulfillment;

2- all gift agreements between the Murray Galinson San Diego-Israel Initiative and San Diego State University (all departments), from January 1, 2023 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

3- any hiring paperwork regarding the placement of Murray Galinson San Diego-Israel Initiative visiting faculty at San Diego State University, from January 1, 2023 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ed Burton

title: Charlie Kirk Assassination - Indiana Attorney General (Fourth Request)

communications.subject: Indiana Access to Public Records Act Request: Charlie Kirk Assassination - Indiana Attorney General (Fourth Request)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Indiana Access to Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any email message sent or received on or after September 10, 2025, by Todd Rokita, Lori Ann Tores, Clinton Bohm, or Michael R. Ward, on the one hand, and any person with an email address on the in.gov domain or a .edu domain, on the other, which contains any of the following terms: "Kirk", "Ball State", "Felicia Gray", "Swierc", "Franklin College", "Colburn", "Henery", "Bloomington", "Maurer", "Dau-Schmidt", "Sanders", "Munden", "Hale", "Kraig", "Blackwelder".

Please note that this request seeks public records wherever they may be found, including on devices or networks owned or operated by private parties. For example, if an employee uses a personal cell phone or social media account to conduct public business, records created, maintained, or held on the phone or account are public records subject to this request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Adam Steinbaugh
